A_FIRE_WEAKNESS.name: Fire Weakness Exploitation
A_FIRE_WEAKNESS.description: Fire attackers dealing 110+ base damage deal 220+ weakness damage, scoring instant 1HKOs on 210 HP Ogerpon.
A_FIRE_WEAKNESS.setup_time: Turn 1-2 with Turbo or manual attach
A_FIRE_WEAKNESS.broad_meta_weakness: Severe disadvantage vs Water (Mega Starmie ex)
A_FIRE_WEAKNESS.policy_compatibility: High (V4 aggressive tempo and KO prioritization)

B_ANTI_EX.name: Safeguard / Anti-Rule-Box Immunity
B_ANTI_EX.description: Single-prize walls that block all damage from Pokemon ex, preventing Ogerpon from taking prizes.
B_ANTI_EX.direct_e19_advantage: High (Hard wall against pure ex attackers)
B_ANTI_EX.broad_meta_weakness: Vulnerable to single-prize attackers (Chi-Yu, Cramorant, Garchomp lines) and bench gust

C_HIGH_HP_TANK.name: High-HP Damage Absorption
C_HIGH_HP_TANK.description: 250-310+ HP bodies that absorb 2-3 hits from Ogerpon before conceding prizes.
C_HIGH_HP_TANK.direct_e19_advantage: Moderate (Forces Ogerpon to over-commit energy to hit 250+)
C_HIGH_HP_TANK.broad_meta_weakness: Can be outpaced by Mega Starmie / Dragapult spread

D_ENERGY_DENIAL.name: Energy Denial & Disruption
D_ENERGY_DENIAL.description: Active and bench energy removal preventing Ogerpon from reaching the 2-3 energy threshold for Myriad Leaf Shower.
D_ENERGY_DENIAL.direct_e19_advantage: High (Disrupts Ogerpon tempo and damage scaling)
D_ENERGY_DENIAL.broad_meta_weakness: Coin-flip variance (50% per hammer); ineffective if opponent accelerates faster than denial rate

E_BENCH_DENIAL.name: Bench Control & Target Selection
E_BENCH_DENIAL.description: Gusting vulnerable bench targets and preventing opponent from safely sheltering wounded Pokemon.
E_BENCH_DENIAL.direct_e19_advantage: High (Picks off bench Ogerpons before they accumulate energy)
E_BENCH_DENIAL.broad_meta_weakness: Requires lethal board pressure to capitalize
E_BENCH_DENIAL.policy_compatibility: High (V4 Pattern 1 & V1 prioritize gust for lethal)

F_PRIZE_CONTROL.name: Prize Trade Manipulation
F_PRIZE_CONTROL.description: Trading 1-prize attackers into 2-prize ex targets, forcing opponent to take 6 KOs while taking only 3.
F_PRIZE_CONTROL.direct_e19_advantage: High (Asymmetric prize clock: 2 prizes gained per KO vs 1 conceded)
F_PRIZE_CONTROL.broad_meta_weakness: Lower individual HP makes single-prizers easy 1HKO targets
F_PRIZE_CONTROL.policy_compatibility: High (V4 prize math naturally leverages asymmetric trades)

G_FAST_BASIC_AGGRESSION.name: Turn 1-2 High Pressure Basic Aggro
G_FAST_BASIC_AGGRESSION.description: High base damage basic attackers attacking on turn 1 or turn 2 with low energy costs.
G_FAST_BASIC_AGGRESSION.direct_e19_advantage: High (Pressures Ogerpon before Teal Dance engine stabilizes)
G_FAST_BASIC_AGGRESSION.policy_compatibility: High (V1 Strong Tactical is natively aggressive)

H_TEAL_DANCE_DISRUPTION.name: Hand & Draw Disruption
H_TEAL_DANCE_DISRUPTION.description: Shrinking opponent hand size to disrupt combo pieces, Bug Catching Sets, and Tera Orbs.
H_TEAL_DANCE_DISRUPTION.direct_e19_advantage: Moderate (Resets Ogerpon hand after massive Teal Dance draws)
H_TEAL_DANCE_DISRUPTION.broad_meta_weakness: Can refresh opponent's dead hand into playable cards

I_DAMAGE_ABSORPTION_REDUCTION.name: Damage Reduction & EHP Expansion
I_DAMAGE_ABSORPTION_REDUCTION.description: Tools and abilities that increase effective HP beyond Ogerpon's 1-shot threshold (210-240).
I_DAMAGE_ABSORPTION_REDUCTION.direct_e19_advantage: High (Pushes Basic ex to 310-330 HP, requiring 3+ attacks to KO)
I_DAMAGE_ABSORPTION_REDUCTION.broad_meta_weakness: Vulnerable to Tool Scrapper (1137) and Megaton Blower (1104)
I_DAMAGE_ABSORPTION_REDUCTION.policy_compatibility: High (V1 attaches tools immediately to active)

J_RESOURCE_EXHAUSTION.name: Resource Depletion & Deckout Pressure
J_RESOURCE_EXHAUSTION.description: Forcing Ogerpon to exhaust energy, Tera Orbs, and gust cards through stall, recycling, and attrition.
J_RESOURCE_EXHAUSTION.direct_e19_advantage: Moderate (Ogerpon burns deck quickly via Teal Dance, making it prone to late-game deckout)
J_RESOURCE_EXHAUSTION.broad_meta_weakness: Slow clock; vulnerable to hyper-aggressive turn-2 KOs
